svg.title: I-ITSM | State pattern and legal incident transitions

g.text: I-ITSM | State pattern and legal incident transitions
NEW -> CLASSIFIED -> ASSIGNED -> ACKNOWLEDGED -> IN_PROGRESS -> RESOLVED -> VERIFIED -> CLOSED
AbstractIncidentState validates allowed successors and transition prerequisites.
IncidentService separately enforces actor permissions and reopening justification.
Solid hollow triangle: inheritance | Dashed hollow triangle: interface realization
Filled diamond: composition | Hollow diamond: shared aggregation
Arrow: stored association | Dashed arrow: dependency
Source snapshot: 22 November 2026 | com.iitsm backend | Explicit members; generated accessors omitted
